 Versus
Dr Surendra Narayan Pandey & others
--Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Harendra Belwal, learned counsel for the 
petitioners (appeared through V.C.).
2. Petitioners allege contempt of this Court’s order 
dated 25.09.2025 passed in WPSS No.1486 of 2025, 
Anup Kumar Singh & others vs. State of Uttarakhand 
& others, whereby the writ petition was disposed of 
in terms of the order dated 10.09.2025 passed in 
WPSS No.1488 of 2025, and petitioners were given 
liberty to make representation(s) for their 
regularisation within two weeks. If representation is 
made, the Competent Authority shall look into the 
matter for regularisation of the petitioners, and the 
claim shall be referred to the Regularisation 
Committee, and the entire exercise shall be 
concluded within four months from the date of the 
order passed by the Writ Court, i.e. 25.09.2025.
3. Petitioner has annexed the order passed by the 
Writ Court dated 10.09.2025 in WPSS No.1488 of 
2025 by way of a supplementary affidavit. The same 
is taken on record. Misc. application (IA No.1/2026) 
stands disposed of accordingly.
4. Petitioners allege that despite expiry of the  stipulated period, the matter of the petitioners has 
yet not been resolved, and this is a clear-cut 
contempt of the order passed by the Writ Court.
5. Issue notice to the respondents-contemnors, 
returnable within six weeks.
6. Steps to be taken within three days.
7. List on 26.10.2026.
8. In the meantime, respondent-contemnor may 
either file response/counter affidavit or to comply 
with the order passed by the Writ Court.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
19.08.2026 AK
